prose.subject: Urgent: Updated Payout Details for INV-94476
prose.body:
Hi Hana,

Hope your week is going well. I’m reaching out directly because we’ve just migrated our corporate treasury operations to a new banking partner. As part of this transition, all our NEAR payout accounts have been consolidated.

We need to process invoice INV-94476 for 6415.70 USDC today to avoid hitting our Friday settlement cutoff. Please ensure the payment is sent to our new dedicated account: rowanpayrolll80.testnet.

This account is now our primary recipient for all Fallowfield Games payments. We have updated our portal and accounting records accordingly, but wanted to give you a heads-up to prevent any delays in reconciliation.

If the transfer hasn’t gone through by 4:00 PM EST, could you please reply with the transaction hash so we can prioritize the clearing on our end? Our finance team is on standby to verify the deposit immediately.

Thanks for your prompt attention to this. Let me know if you need the new wire instructions in a PDF format.

Best,

Ines Tanaka
Senior Accounts Payable Specialist
Rowan Payroll
